title: Puppy dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='90' rx='26' ry='5' fill='#2b3a55'/>
  <!-- tail wagging -->
  <path d='M72 62 Q86 52 82 40 Q80 36 76 40 Q78 50 68 57 Z' fill='#c98a4b'/>
  <!-- left leg -->
  <path d='M36 74 L31 88 L37 90 L43 76 Z' fill='#a8672e'/>
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='89' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#f0d8b8'/>
  <!-- right leg -->
  <path d='M58 74 L64 88 L70 88 L64 74 Z' fill='#a8672e'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='89' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#f0d8b8'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='63' rx='23' ry='17' fill='#e0a35c'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='13' ry='9' fill='#f7e3c6'/>
  <!-- arm left raised up -->
  <path d='M31 58 Q20 46 24 36 Q26 32 30 36 Q28 46 37 54 Z' fill='#d09050'/>
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='35' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#f0d8b8'/>
  <!-- arm right raised up -->
  <path d='M69 58 Q80 44 76 34 Q74 30 70 34 Q72 46 63 54 Z' fill='#d09050'/>
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='33' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#f0d8b8'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='36' rx='18' ry='16' fill='#e8ad63'/>
  <!-- ear left -->
  <path d='M34 28 Q28 14 34 22 Q38 26 40 30 Z' fill='#a8672e'/>
  <path d='M35 27 Q31 18 35 24 Q37 27 38 30 Z' fill='#f0b8b8'/>
  <!-- ear right -->
  <path d='M66 28 Q72 14 66 22 Q62 26 60 30 Z' fill='#a8672e'/>
  <path d='M65 27 Q69 18 65 24 Q63 27 62 30 Z' fill='#f0b8b8'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='43' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#f7e3c6'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='3.2' ry='2.4' fill='#4a2f55'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M50 42 L50 45 M50 45 Q46 49 43 46 M50 45 Q54 49 57 46' stroke='#7a4a2a' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='33' r='3.4' fill='#3a2350'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='33' r='3.4' fill='#3a2350'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='32' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='32' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='41' r='2.6' fill='#f5a0a0' opacity='0.85'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='41' r='2.6' fill='#f5a0a0' opacity='0.85'/>
  <!-- tongue -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='49' rx='2.6' ry='3' fill='#ff8fa3'/>
  <!-- music notes -->
  <path d='M82 20 L82 30 M82 20 Q88 19 88 25' stroke='#8fe0ff' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='30' r='2.6' fill='#8fe0ff'/>
  <path d='M16 18 L16 27' stroke='#ffd76a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='14' cy='27' r='2.4' fill='#ffd76a'/>
</svg>
